def transform(grid):
    """Return a 2x2 block of the color whose vertical marker lengths
    differ most between the regions above and below the horizontal divider.
    """
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    above = grid[:divider]
    below = grid[divider + 1:]
    differences = {}
    for color in colors:
        upper_count = sum(cell == color for row in above for cell in row)
        lower_count = sum(cell == color for row in below for cell in row)
        differences[color] = abs(upper_count - lower_count)
    winner = max(colors, key=lambda c: differences[c])
    return [[winner, winner], [winner, winner]]
